name: Hossana

queries.query: Hossana Ethiopia official cadastral parcel map GIS land registry
queries.result: Found the official Hossana municipal portal and an official Central Ethiopia land-development/management agency regulation. The municipal portal exposes land-holding information registration services but no anonymous parcel map/API was identified.

queries.query: ሆሳዕና ኢትዮጵያ ካዳስተር የመሬት ምዝገባ ካርታ
queries.result: Found the official Hossana municipal portal (El-ሆሳዕና), which lists የመሬት ይዞታ መረጃ ምዝገባ (land-holding information registration) and የካዳስተር ጉዳይ (cadastral matter) service workflow. No public parcel geometry endpoint was exposed.

attemptsRecorded.outcome: Official Hossana municipal portal and Central Ethiopia land-management agency source found.
